verification.observation: The dated pricelist and computation sheets identify individual lots. Only a generic 96 sqm package-price reference is released.
Lot-specific computations contain dated schedules, different financing assumptions and discounts. Public validity is unconfirmed.
verification.action: Do not publish raw computations, discounts or monthly amounts until a current public offer is approved.

verification.observation: Reference website advertises swimming pool, security and playground. Supplied seminar instead identifies clubhouse, basketball court, parks and jogging path.
verification.action: Use supplied seminar list and confirm current amenities; omit conflicting website claims.

verification.observation: Website says provision for two bathrooms; supplied model sheets explicitly specify two toilets and baths.
verification.action: Use primary model sheets and confirm offered turnover specifications.

verification.observation: Marketing pages show L.D. December 2030. It does not establish the turnover date of every home.
verification.action: Keep original wording and request contract-specific completion and turnover.

verification.observation: Furnished marketing schedule and source photos show different fit-out stages.
verification.action: Show schedule as advertised, with written inclusions required.

verification.observation: All 47 HEIC photographs contain GPS metadata.
verification.action: Publish full-resolution JPEG conversions with EXIF/GPS removed; source HEICs stay in supplied folder.

verification.observation: Shared styled photographs and nine interior renders do not identify a model.
verification.action: Keep shared project media separate; do not assign to a specific model.

verification.observation: interior 5.jpg and interior4.jpg have the same SHA-256.
verification.action: Keep two source records with one physical output asset.

verification.observation: Supplied vicinity map labels some landmarks as very soon. Distances are publisher estimates.
verification.action: Use schematic map and neutral landmark names; verify openings and route before viewing.

verification.observation: Developer assets supplied for JMG use; independent licensing and regulator validation are not supplied.
verification.action: Retain source attribution and obtain any required redistribution clearance; verify regulatory claims before treating them as independently confirmed.

verification.observation: Pricing material also contains nonstandard lot-size examples tied to individual inventory.
verification.action: Do not create additional model types or publish inventory-specific variants; request public variant sheets.
